claire: Heads-up — ran a quick bringup for a skip-ahead speculative window on a quant-4bit model (ozma-13b). Seeing intermittent KV staleness after warmup that nudges early-token choices and hurts short-chat p50. Notes below.

devin: plz paste numbers?

claire: quick dump:
```
model=ozma-13b-4bitq
spec_window=6
warmup=3tokens
p50=24ms p95=88ms
tokens_sec=420
quality_squad_exact=0.78 -> 0.74 (regression)
```
observed: first ~2s of stream returns slightly off-token choices vs baseline non-spec. Seems tied to a fallback merge during early KV churn.

sam: can confirm on commonsenseQA small sample — F1 down ~1.2 pts. Correlated when KV-pop occurs mid-sequence.

lia: do we have the eval harness run and seeds? how many samples?

claire: ran 3 seeds (0,1,2) on the 500-sample microbench; signal consistent across seeds. Suspect quant rounding + speculative branch ordering causes top-k reorder, and when we later merge fallback tokens we sometimes reapply old KV slices -> staleness.

devin: hypothesis: skip-ahead window + quantized attention weights -> shift in topk which produces a different cache write ordering. When fallback merges, cache versioning isn't strict so later reads see old kv. Proposal: add per-request cache-version tag and validate on merge.

sam: yes. Also propose token-alignment metric (fraction of token positions identical to baseline) and delta-perplexity on heldout to quantify.

lia: quick ablation plan:
- disable skip-ahead for warmup < 8 tokens
- increase spec_window to 8 and compare
- run FP16 KV shadow (non-quant) to see if mismatch disappears

claire: enqueue and running. small script used:
```bash
# microbench runner
./run_spec.sh --model ozma-13b-4bitq --spec-window 6 --warmup 3 --seed $SEED
# produces: latency.csv, token_delta.json, logits_dump.tar
```

perf-bot: Perf job queued: job-id 7812 — ETA ~2h

devin: good. For final eval we should include: prod-shadow 500 chats + adversarial prompt set + standard QA (SQuAD) so we catch both fluency and factual regressions.

sam: also please log token-level logits for the first 10 tokens after warmup for a few examples — will help debug ordering.

claire: agreed. if ablation shows regression >0.5 abs on any safety/utility metric, we default to disabling speculative decode on quant models for now. :thumbsup:

lia: thanks. if anyone sees 502/timeout in canaries ping eng-sre immediately.

devin: cc @ops-sre

claire: I'll drop a short blurb into the model-onboard doc and update the rollout checklist when we have ablation results.
